name: 8050-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. An 8B model on one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 30% by request count, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: ShareGPT V3 conversational prompts, single turn, shipped with the item as `configs/data/sharegpt-v3-llama3-2400.jsonl` (2400 rows, guidellm `json_file`). Prompts mean 224 tokens (p50 106, max 1020), outputs mean 202 (p50 141, max 1838). Output length is pinned per request -- guidellm sets `ignore_eos` with `max_tokens`, so every request generates exactly its row's completion length -- and `request_format: "plain"` in scenario.json sends the row's text unwrapped rather than through a chat template.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant handling brief conversational turns for 256 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. A source checkout, so the interpreter is named by configs/env.yaml.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

# HAZARD, three constraints of this engine at num-scheduler-steps > 1: chunked prefill must be
# off (the engine raises otherwise), speculative decoding is refused, and the engine switches
# itself to BlockSpaceManagerV2 with a warning.
num-scheduler-steps: 8

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The engine's own defaults at this commit, written out rather than inherited. max-num-seqs is
# also what bounds KV demand: raising it invites preemption at this workload.
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

enable-chunked-prefill: false
disable-log-requests: true
